title: A Policy That Is a Straight Line: Least Squares on the Demonstrations, the Gains It Finds, and the Limit It Cannot Fit

artifact.note: the simplest learned policy: a turn rate that is a weighted sum of the offset and the heading error plus a constant, fitted to the demonstrations by least squares (the normal equations, three by three, solved by elimination with pivoting), with a ridge term that pulls the weights toward zero; it finds the expert's gains exactly where the expert never reached its limit, and shrunk, with an error it cannot remove, where the expert's turn was clipped
